title: SplashBI opens GCC in Hyderabad, to invest over $100M
summary: SplashBI opens Hyderabad global capability center with a planned $100 million investment
detailed: SplashBI opened a new 20,000-square-foot global capability centre (GCC) in Hyderabad with a capacity for 275 professionals.
The company plans to invest over $100 million over the next five to seven years in infrastructure, technology, and talent in Hyderabad.
The facility consolidates local teams to support platform engineering, AI development, domain analytics, and customer delivery.
The new center aims to enhance enterprise data connectivity and help customers adopt AI with proper business context.
sentences: SplashBI, a Georgia (US)-headquartered enterprise data intelligence platform, has opened its global capability centre (GCC) in Hyderabad.

The company plans to invest over $100 million over the next five to seven years in infrastructure, technology and talent to scale the Hyderabad centre and strengthen its global product engineering and delivery capabilities, a release said.
The 20,000-square-foot facility, with capacity for 275 professionals, was inaugurated by Telangana IT Minister D Sridhar Babu.
SplashBI has had a presence in Hyderabad since 2014.
The new facility brings its teams in the city together under one roof, designed to support collaboration and growth, the release said.

The centre will support the development of SplashBI’s data intelligence platform and global customer delivery, helping enterprises connect business data, establish shared business context and use that data for decisions, AI, analytics and reporting, it said.
Platform engineering, AI development, domain analytics and customer delivery teams will work closely together at the Global Capability Center, the release said.
They will work on data connectivity and business modelling, develop SplashAI capabilities and support customer implementations.
“Enterprises need a practical way to turn the data they already have into decisions they can trust.
That requires understanding how their business works, connecting information across functions and giving people useful ways to explore it,” said Naveen Miglani, CEO and Co-Founder of SplashBI.
“Our Hyderabad centre strengthens the engineering and customer expertise behind that work, as we help customers advance their data foundations and adopt AI with the right business context,” he added.

Kiran Reddy Pasham, President and Co-Founder of SplashBI, said, “Our teams in Hyderabad will build the platform capabilities and domain content that help customers connect their data, make sense of it and use it in their everyday work.”
